candidates: Fibrofatty residua of involuted infantile hemangioma
key_facts: The patient is an adolescent girl
The condition has been present since infancy
The mass is located on the right flank
The mass is soft and exophytic
The mass has overlying pinpoint vessels and branching telangiectasia
The initial measurements were 0.8 cm high and 7.5 cm wide
The mass caused concern for appearance and fullness
The lesion is composed of mature adipose and fibrous tissues
champion: Fibrofatty residua of involuted infantile hemangioma

raw.champion: Fibrofatty residua of involuted infantile hemangioma
raw.rationale: The condition has been present since infancy, and the mass is soft and exophytic with overlying pinpoint vessels and branching telangiectasia, which are characteristic features of involuted infantile hemangioma. The composition of mature adipose and fibrous tissues also supports this diagnosis.

rejected.label: Fibrolipoma
rejected.why: While fibrolipoma could explain the composition of mature adipose and fibrous tissues, it does not typically present with the vascular features seen in this case.

rejected.label: Hamartoma
rejected.why: Hamartoma is a broad term that could encompass a variety of tissue types, but it does not specifically explain the combination of clinical and histological findings in this case.

rejected.label: Lipoma
rejected.why: Lipoma is a benign tumor composed of adipose tissue, but it does not typically have the exophytic growth pattern, vascular features, or combination of adipose and fibrous tissues seen in this case.
